label: Two fixture ROUTER.md files under .skilled/skills/sk-doc/scripts/tests/ have no sibling SKILL.md, so the natural inverse invariant (every ROUTER.md belongs to a skill) reports 57 routers for 55 skills. Both are referenced by test_validator.py:128 and :136, so they cannot simply be deleted; exclude scripts/tests/** or move them outside the skills tree.

The hub copy and the sk-create-skill copy of package_skill.py are byte-identical (83,560 bytes, SHA-256 prefix 69a5f164a4a65e8d). Each caller invokes its local path, so removing one without repointing breaks that caller; a symlink or one shared script with two entry points keeps both working.

The sk-doc registry declares workflowMode sk-create-skill-parent with no sk-create-skill-parent/ directory; it resolves through packet sk-create-skill. The doctor invariant compares folder leaf to packetSkillName, so it passes, but a resolver that maps workflowMode to a folder reports a false missing packet. State that packet is authoritative or add a schema check that every modes[] entry resolves through packet.

At head, all 55 real SKILL.md files have a sibling ROUTER.md and at least one markdown link resolving to their own ./ROUTER.md; all seven hub mode-registry mode sets equal their hub-router.json routerPolicy.tieBreak sets and appear in the hub ROUTER.md.
At tag v4.0.1.0 there are exactly 54 SKILL.md and 56 ROUTER.md; the two extra routers are the sk-doc validator fixtures.
For all seven hubs, mode-registry.json version, SKILL.md version and hub-router.json version are identical; ROUTER.md carries an independent document version.
